scope: Fresh CPU development regression of preview command parsing and abstention; independent of the completed 15-session usability smoke. Run once per before/after implementation, with a fresh session per case.

rubrics.subtract: Exactly one calculate/subtract event with the declared ordered operands, ok=true and an answer numerically equal to its actual result. Counterfactual fixtures supply the prior event only; no ideal result substitution.
rubrics.missing_prior: Zero calls and explicit missing/unsuccessful prior evidence.
rubrics.clarify: Zero calls and a request identifying missing or ambiguous subtraction operands/direction.
rubrics.denied: Zero calls and an explicit tool-permission denial.
rubrics.expression: Zero calls and an unevaluated 44 minus 17 expression; evaluated answer is not accepted.
rubrics.unavailable: Zero calls and a clear live-service capability limitation.
rubrics.no_call: Zero calls; prose quality outside this negative-control check.
